option.erydon.gallery.aganite.descriptio: From agate + -ite: a vivid, polished gemstone texture. Based on agate gemstones.
option.erydon.gallery.aterzon.descriptio: From Lat. ater = black + zone = band: a black striped stone. Based on Panda Marble.
option.erydon.gallery.borealis.descripti: From Lat. borealis = northern: a cold stone with polar light. Based on labradorite.
option.erydon.gallery.brectite.descripti: From breccia = broken stone + -ite: a fragmentary marble. Based on Breche de Vendome.
option.erydon.gallery.calacattum.descrip: From Calacatta + Lat. -um: a fine white-gold marble. Based on Calacatta Oro.
option.erydon.gallery.chalstrom.descript: From Gk. chalkos = bronze + storm: a copper-storm stone. Based on Tempest Gold.
option.erydon.gallery.chrysonyx.descript: From Gk. chrysos = gold + onyx: black stone threaded with gold. Based on black and gold onyx.
option.erydon.gallery.etruscus.descripti: From Lat. Etruscus = Etruscan: a dark classical green stone. Based on dark green Etruscan marble.
option.erydon.gallery.gelastrum.descript: From Lat. gelu = frost + astrum = star: a blue frost-star stone. Based on Azul Macaubas quartzite.
option.erydon.gallery.glacium.descriptio: From Lat. glacies = ice: a cold white stone with frozen grey veins. Based on Statuario marble.
option.erydon.gallery.hesperion.descript: From Gk. hesperos = evening, western: a twilight-blue stone. Based on sodalite-blue stone.
option.erydon.gallery.imperium.descripti: From Lat. imperium = command, empire: a heavy imperial dark marble. Based on Emperador Dark.
option.erydon.gallery.kelastrion.descrip: From Gk. kelainos = dark + astron = star: a dark star-flecked stone. Based on Belgian Blue limestone.
option.erydon.gallery.kylorion.descripti: From Kyllene's wooded slopes + -ion: a green forest stone. Based on Rainforest marble.
option.erydon.gallery.latmion.descriptio: From Latmos, the moon-haunted mountain: a pale milk-stone. Based on limestone.
option.erydon.gallery.laurentium.descrip: From Lat. laurus = laurel: a dark laurel-veined stone. Based on Noir Saint Laurent marble.
option.erydon.gallery.mielonyx.descripti: From miel = honey + onyx: a warm honey-stone. Based on honey onyx.
option.erydon.gallery.nerium.description: From Lat. nerium = oleander: a dark, poisonous-flower stone. Based on Nero Marquina marble.
option.erydon.gallery.noxoplis.descripti: From Lat. nox = night + opalus = opal: a night-opal stone. Based on black opal.
option.erydon.gallery.porphyros.descript: From Gk. porphyra = purple: a purple-red mineral stone. Based on Rosso Orobico marble.
option.erydon.gallery.portorium.descript: From Lat. portus = harbour + Portoro: a harbour-gold stone. Based on Portoro marble.
option.erydon.gallery.psamatheon.descrip: From Psamathe, a sea-sand Nereid: a pale shore-stone. Based on sandstone.
option.erydon.gallery.rosinium.descripti: From rose + -inium: a rosy dawn-stone. Based on Rosa Portugalo marble.
option.erydon.gallery.sanguenite.descrip: From Lat. sanguis = blood + -ite: a deep blood-stone. Based on Rosso Levanto marble.
option.erydon.gallery.selenephos.descrip: From Gk. Selene = moon goddess + phos = light: a moonlit stone. Based on pink alabaster.
option.erydon.gallery.solistra.descripti: From Lat. sol = sun + strata = layers: a layered sun-stone. Based on Giallo Siena marble.
option.erydon.gallery.striatus.descripti: From Lat. striatus = grooved, striped: a lined spring-stone. Based on striped travertine.
